playbook.app_side_fix: Find and fix launch failures on the current version; if an install-source or integrity check blocks genuine Play installs, make it fail open with logging instead of locking users out.
playbook.first_diagnostic_check: Play Console > Android vitals: crash and ANR rate for the newest version vs the previous one, split by device and Android version. Search crash logs for the 'not installed from Play Store' path.
playbook.missing_data: Android vitals by version/device; integrity-check failure counts; whether the check is configurable per client; share of users on company-managed (MDM) devices.
playbook.success_metric: Crash/launch-failure mentions in 1-2★ reviews back to the pre-release share within 2 releases; user-perceived crash rate below Play's bad-behaviour threshold.

playbook.app_side_fix: Stop silent logouts (session/token refresh), add OTP retry with a second channel (SMS ⇄ email/WhatsApp) and a visible resend timer.
playbook.first_diagnostic_check: OTP delivery success rate by carrier and hour from the SMS gateway; session-expiry and forced-logout events per user per week.
playbook.missing_data: OTP send/deliver/verify funnel; logout events with reason codes.
playbook.success_metric: OTP delivered-to-verified rate ≥ 97%; forced logouts per active user per month down 80%; login/OTP mentions in 1-2★ halved.

issuesDetailed.label: Routing, ride length, or pickup time

examples.text: When trying to reach helpdesk, the line disconnects. Cab ETA keeps changing and the worst part is routing & pickup timings, spending over 2 hours to reach office with in Gurugram
Genpact cabs can make u travel through the entire city With charging. Sequences are like wow.

MoveOutSync doesn't plan commutes; it plans cross-country pilgrimages. The ETA is an abstract joke where a 1-hour delay is considered punctual. The routing algorithm is pure genius: it clubs passengers from two different states into one cab at 8 AM, while empty cabs glide right past us. If you want a free Bharat Darshan tour before reaching office, this is it. Coding isn't for everyone-definitely not for the monkeys who built this. Try copying Routematic fools.

playbook.app_side_fix: Explain each pickup time (stop N of M, client buffer), show expected ride time at booking, rotate first-pickup position, flag rides over 2.5× the direct time.
playbook.first_diagnostic_check: Per employee: ride time vs direct-trip time and route position over the last month, per client.
playbook.missing_data: Route plans with per-rider ride time and position; client settings for buffers, fleet size, max ride time.
playbook.success_metric: Share of rides over 2.5× direct time; complaints about pickup time/ride length in 1-2★ down 40%.
